description: List reciters with audio recitations (recitation per ayah or per surah, mp3/ogg). Filter by language code, or by a name fragment.

language.description: ISO language code of the recitation, for example ar

query.description: part of the reciter name, for example mishary

name: list_reciters

mode.description: versebyverse (one file per ayah) or surahbysurah (one file per surah)
